column4: cleat#3687: these tests build their shards from real PostgreSQL databases (newRealShards -> bootstrapScratchDB), and sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration -- no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists (same reason as a-deprecate-and-purge-take-the-cross-shard-lock.tsv). They skip as bare test names. Six skips: the six top-level tests in a_run_starting_mid_purge_leaves_the_shards_agreeing_test.go and a_purge_commit_phase_and_bound_test.go. multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so they skip here.

cleat#3687: same six tests, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. They run, and pass, under test-go/engine and cluster, which set the PostgreSQL DSN.
